title.en: Send one UDP query and get an answer
title.hinglish: Ek UDP query bhejo aur jawab lo

why.en: A normal DNS lookup is a single UDP datagram to port 53 with no handshake.
why.hinglish: Normal DNS lookup port 53 par ek single UDP datagram hota hai, bina handshake ke.

expect.en: The IP address(es) of example.com, answered by 1.1.1.1. It comes back in one round trip because there is no connection setup. Addresses may vary.
expect.hinglish: example.com ke IP address(es), 1.1.1.1 ke jawab ke saath. Yeh ek round trip mein aa jata hai kyunki connection setup nahi hota. Addresses alag ho sakte hain.

title.en: List UDP sockets on your machine
title.hinglish: Apni machine ke UDP sockets list karo

why.en: UDP sockets have no state like ESTABLISHED; they are just ports waiting for datagrams.
why.hinglish: UDP sockets ka ESTABLISHED jaisa koi state nahi hota; woh bas datagrams ka intezaar karte ports hain.

expect.en: A list of local UDP ports (for example 53, 123 or 5353) with no state column. Entries differ per machine; on macOS use netstat -an -p udp.
expect.hinglish: Local UDP ports ki list (jaise 53, 123 ya 5353), state column ke bina. Entries har machine par alag hoti hain; macOS par netstat -an -p udp use karo.

title.en: Find the UDP datagrams in the capture

why.en: Open the .pcap in Wireshark and filter on UDP and the ICMP error.
why.hinglish: .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur UDP aur ICMP error par filter lagao.

expect.en: The 20 ms voice datagrams with an 8-byte UDP header, and in the second scenario an ICMP Destination Unreachable (port unreachable).
expect.hinglish: 8-byte UDP header wale 20 ms ke voice datagrams, aur doosre scenario mein ICMP Destination Unreachable (port unreachable).
